summary: Iter 56: Tested Apple App Review demo account + first-time onboarding on backend + mobile + web regression. Backend 6/7 pytest passing. Mobile onboarding wizard end-to-end works flawlessly (Welcome → Research → Capital(25000) → Alloc(fixed $1000) → Strategies(hunter) → Summary → Start Paper Trading → lands on /tabs). Skip flow, replay from Account, and non-reappearance after completion all verified. Account screen shows System Health card (Backend/Trading Mode/Live Gate); Workspace no longer contains Live Gate. Web owner login regression: page loads cleanly, no onboarding on web. Found ONE backend response-shape bug in /api/auth/login (hardcodes owner) — token/role in JWT are correct so no UI impact today, but response is misleading for any client that trusts it.

minor.issue: Response body hardcodes role='owner' and email=OWNER_EMAIL regardless of who logged in (server.py:1385). Demo user (review@ananta.ai) receives {"email": "owner@ananta.ai", "role": "owner"} in the response body. JWT itself correctly carries role='demo' and sub='review@ananta.ai' — /auth/me returns the right values — so the mobile UI (Account screen) shows the correct email. Impact today is cosmetic/API-contract only, but any client that consumes the login response directly would misidentify the demo user. Fix: return {"token": token, "email": email.strip().lower(), "role": role_from_authenticate_result}. Requires authenticate() to return role alongside token.

action_items: Fix /api/auth/login response to reflect the actual authenticated user (email + role from JWT payload) — currently hardcodes owner. Low priority (cosmetic; JWT + /auth/me are correct).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1385 — auth_login returns hardcoded owner identity regardless of who authenticated. `authenticate()` returns only the token; refactor it to return (token, role) or decode the JWT before responding so the login response matches the JWT contents. This is a footgun for any future client relying on the login response body.

rca of the issue: Bug: /api/auth/login returns hardcoded {email: OWNER_EMAIL, role: 'owner'} because the endpoint was written before the demo role existed and never updated to reflect authenticate()'s multi-role output. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/auth/login -d '{"email":"review@ananta.ai","password":"AnantaDemo123!"}'` → response contains role='owner' and email='owner@ananta.ai'. Mitigation: change `authenticate()` to return (token, email, role) tuple (or decode the JWT before responding) and thread those into the response body.
